blocks.content: With your data source selected, choose which metric to monitor. The metric dropdown populates based on the data source you selected.
To select a metric, complete the following steps:

Click the **Metric** dropdown and search for or select the measurement you want to alert on.

| What you want to monitor | Example metric |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| CPU usage | `node_cpu_seconds_total` |
| Memory usage | `node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes` |
| HTTP requests | `http_requests_total` |
| Disk I/O | `node_disk_io_time_seconds_total` |
If you don't see the metric you expect, verify you selected the correct data source in the previous step.
Your metric is selected. Next, you'll add label filters to narrow the results.
